---
title: "RFC 010: Ingestion Provenance Phase"
subtitle: "Deterministic Folder Resolution and Staged Receipts"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase completes the provenance layout step from RFC 008 by adding deterministic folder resolution and staged receipt writing with ledger integration. The new helpers resolve a provenance hash into a stable folder, write receipts atomically, and flag duplicate hashes via the ledger. Unit tests confirm determinism and duplicate handling.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Provenance layout | `resolve_provenance_folder` | Hashes relative path + metadata to a folder. |
| Receipt staging | `stage_provenance_receipt` | Writes receipt and records ledger state. |
| Ledger support | Duplicate flagging | Marks duplicates without overwriting receipts. |

: Table 1. Provenance phase deliverables.

| File | Change |

## Appendix A: Behaviors

- Deterministic folder names are derived from relative ingest path + metadata hash inputs.
- Receipt writes are atomic, and duplicate hashes are flagged in ledger metadata.
